entities.name: Jovan Dragaš

entities.summary: Jovan Dejanović, known as Jovan Dragaš, was a Serbian nobleman who held the title of despot under the Serbian Emperor Uroš V, his cousin. He later became an Ottoman vassal after the Battle of Maritsa in 1371.
